facts.claim: Under Law 47-06 (articles 70-76) the stay tax in tourist accommodation is charged per person and per night, added to the accommodation price, children under 12 are exempt, operators are responsible for collecting it, and invoices must show the amount separately; it is paid quarterly to the commune.

sources.title: Law 47-06 on local taxation, consolidated text hosted by the DGI (Arabic), articles 70-76 and 168

articles/where-to-stay-in-marrakech.html: it is added to the accommodation price, and children under 12 are exempt
invoices must show the amount on its own line

facts.claim: Article 73 of Law 47-06 sets legal ranges per person per night: guest houses, congress centres and luxury hotels MAD 15-30; riads and houses rented to tourists MAD 10-25; hotels 5 stars MAD 10-25, 4 stars 5-10, 3 stars 3-7, 1-2 stars 2-5; tourist residences 3-7; other tourist accommodation 2-5. Under article 168 the rate within the range is fixed by a decision of the commune after council approval; the Marrakech commune's own rate was not found.

sources.title: Law 47-06 on local taxation, consolidated text hosted by the DGI (Arabic), articles 70-76 and 168

articles/where-to-stay-in-marrakech.html: MAD 10 to 25
under its article 168 the rate is fixed by a decision of the commune after the communal council approves it
We could not find the rate the Marrakech council has set

facts.claim: The DGI's VAT page lists accommodation and restaurant services at the 10% reduced rate; the standard rate is 20%.

sources.title: DGI: Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée

facts.claim: Editors' arithmetic: two adults, four nights, legal range MAD 10-25 gives MAD 80-200; a MAD 1,800 room for four nights is MAD 7,200 and 10% VAT is MAD 720.

sources.title: Law 47-06 on local taxation, consolidated text hosted by the DGI (Arabic), articles 70-76 and 168

four nights come to MAD 7,200 and the VAT is MAD 720

facts.claim: In December 2025 Supratours replaced Alsa, which had run Marrakech's city buses for 26 years; at the handover the standard fare was reported at MAD 5, with approved increases to follow the Africa Cup of Nations.

sources.title: Morocco World News: Supratours replaces ALSA as Marrakech bus operator
Alsa Maroc home page: lists Rabat, Casablanca, Khouribga and Agadir, not Marrakech

the standard fare was reported at MAD 5

facts.claim: Hotels' own pages give the drive from Marrakech Menara airport as 9 minutes (Es Saadi), 15 minutes (Sofitel, El Fenn) and 20 minutes (Radisson Blu, 3.88 km).

articles/where-to-stay-in-marrakech.html: Es Saadi says 9 minutes, Sofitel 15 and Radisson Blu 20

facts.claim: Radisson Blu Marrakech Carré Eden's directions: bus L18 from the airport at Jardin Menara towards Alfadl, exit at Grand Poste and walk 500 m. Hotel's own directions, not an operator timetable; no official fare for the airport service (tourist guides' line 19) was found.

articles/where-to-stay-in-marrakech.html: take bus L18 from the airport, at Jardin Menara towards Alfadl, and get off at Grand Poste

facts.claim: El Fenn's directions say no cars are allowed in the medina and a taxi can be taken outside its boutique entrance at Bab el Ksour; Les Borjs de la Kasbah says it is easily accessible by taxi, minibus and horse-drawn calèche; Royal Mansour describes winding alleyways between its riads.

facts.claim: El Fenn (Bab El Ksour, Medina) describes 41 individually styled rooms and suites, three swimming pools, a 1,300 square metre roof terrace; its Small and Cosy rooms are listed from EUR 342.

facts.claim: Les Jardins de la Koutoubia (26 rue de la Koutoubia) has 108 rooms, three restaurants and a spa in a riad it dates to the 13th century; the Medina Room is 30 m².

facts.claim: Royal Mansour Marrakech (Rue Abou El Abbas Sebti) has 53 riads, from the 140 m² Superior riad to the 1,800 m² Grand riad; its site publishes no room rates.

facts.claim: Equity Point Marrakech describes itself as a hostel in a 15th-century riad in the heart of the Medina, with a large pool, terraces with hammocks, a bar and restaurant, private rooms and 4- to 10-bed dorms; Booking.com lists the address as Derb El Hammam, Mouassine.

facts.claim: La Maison Arabe (1 Derb Assehbé, Bab Doukkala) has two swimming pools, a spa with a hammam, a piano-jazz bar, a cooking school and a restaurant that has served since 1946; its Country Club is a short shuttle ride away in the Palmeraie.

facts.claim: Les Borjs de la Kasbah, in the Kasbah quarter yards from the Royal Palace, was built over four years from six small town houses and a riad, with a pool, spa and restaurant.

facts.claim: Marrakech Riads Angsana Heritage Collection (24 Derb Si Said) is an Accor collection of riads, each an individual heritage house, with a restaurant, rooftop terraces and a plunge pool, 700 m from Jemaa el-Fna by Accor's count.

facts.claim: Radisson Blu Marrakech Carré Eden (166-176 Avenue Mohamed V) is a five-star in Gueliz; its page lists rooms from 35 m², the Majorelle Garden 1.14 km, the medina 2.52 km, Jemaa el-Fnaa 2.34 km, the railway station 1.2 km, and a lowest rate of EUR 250.86 a night for the next 60 days (read 20 October 2026).

facts.claim: Sofitel Marrakech Palais Impérial & Spa (Rue Haroun Errachid, Hivernage) is a five-star with four pools (one heated all year), four restaurants, two bars and a kids' club; the hotel says it is a 15-minute walk from the Koutoubia and Jemaa el-Fna.
